description: At least one purchase item is required. Each line's unit price comes from the vendor's price list for its quantity, unless `override_unit_price` is sent. The subtotal and total are always worked out by Wherefour.

purchase_number.description: Defaults to the next purchase order number

payment_term_id.description: Defaults to the vendor's payment term

delivery_method_id.description: Defaults to the vendor's delivery method

bill_to_address_id.description: A facility address. Defaults to the organization's main address

deliver_to_address_id.description: A facility address. Defaults to the organization's main address

items.description: Either inventory ID or SKU is required

override_unit_price.description: Replaces the vendor price list's unit price for this line
